faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to your questions about KWISMO protection.

items.q: How does KWISMO protect me against Mobile Money fraud?
items.a: KWISMO analyzes incoming calls and transaction recipients in real time using our AI engine and community database. Before running a USSD code or answering a suspicious call, a clear visual alert warns you of the risk level.

items.q: Does the app work without an internet connection?
items.a: Yes! KWISMO includes a secure local database on your device. During USSD transfers or offline calls, number verification and USSD code generation are handled locally.
KWISMO supports all major operators across Central and West Africa, including MTN (MoMo), Orange Money, MoMo Express, Camtel, Moov, Wave, and Airtel Money.

items.q: Is my personal and financial information secure?
items.a: Absolutely. KWISMO never has access to your Mobile Money PIN code or account balance. All data is encrypted on your device and no passwords are stored in plain text.

items.q: How much does KWISMO cost for an individual user?
items.a: The KWISMO mobile app is 100% free for individual users. You can download it freely from Google Play and the App Store.

items.q: How do I integrate the KWISMO API into my business or FinTech?
items.a: KWISMO offers a highly available REST API (Pay-as-you-go at $0.001 per API call). You can check our interactive Swagger documentation and submit a partner request directly on this website.
